name: @clarity/api-service
description: Thin HTTP layer over the command services. The first (and only) path where identity is verified: every request authenticates a bearer token through @clarity/auth-service and builds its CommandActor via actorFor(), so tenant and roles come from the database-backed principal — never from the request body. One command exposed end-to-end (RecordDecisionRationale); no framework, no PHI, no UI.
